systems.name: Wyoming Retirement System (Public Employee, Law Enforcement and Air Guard Firefighter plans)

statute.quote: The Wyoming retirement system is established to provide retirement and other benefits to eligible employees of participating employers.

source.quote: The responsibility for the administration and operation of the retirement system is vested solely and exclusively in the Wyoming retirement board.

website_source.quote: The Wyoming Retirement System administers pension and 457(b) deferred compensation plans for Wyoming's public employees.

covers_local_source.quote: "Employer" or "participating employer" means: (A) The state of Wyoming and any department, board, commission or other agency or instrumentality of the state; (B) Any county, county memorial hospital, special hospital district, city or town

systems.notes: Census lists the Public Employee, Law Enforcement and Air Guard Firefighter plans separately; all are member classes of the Wyoming retirement system under W.S. 9-3-401 et seq. (air guard firefighters are "firefighter members" under W.S. 9-3-402).

systems.name: Wyoming State Patrol, Game and Fish Warden and Criminal Investigator Retirement Program

statute.quote: There is created the retirement program which is for the benefit of the employees defined in W.S. 9-3-602(a)(v).

source.quote: The administration and responsibility for the operation of the retirement program is under the direction and control of the board.

website_source.quote: The Wyoming Retirement System administers pension and 457(b) deferred compensation plans for Wyoming's public employees.

systems.notes: Covers highway patrol troopers, game and fish wardens and DCI criminal investigators (W.S. 9-3-602(a)(v)).

systems.name: Wyoming Judicial Retirement Program

statute.quote: There is created the retirement program which is for the benefit of the employees defined in W.S. 9-3-702(a)(v).

source.quote: The administration and responsibility for the operation of the retirement program is under the direction and control of the board.

website_source.quote: The Wyoming Retirement System administers pension and 457(b) deferred compensation plans for Wyoming's public employees.

systems.notes: Supreme court justices and district, chancery and circuit court judges (W.S. 9-3-702(a)(v)); Census calls it the Judicial Pension Fund.

systems.name: Wyoming Paid Firemen's Pension Plan A

statute.quote: There is created a firemen's pension account for the purpose of paying the awards, benefits and pensions under the provisions of this article.

source.quote: The account shall be administered by the board through the director. The board has full custody and control of the account with full power over its administration.

website_source.quote: The Wyoming Retirement System administers pension and 457(b) deferred compensation plans for Wyoming's public employees.

systems.notes: Closed plan for paid municipal firefighters hired before July 1, 1981 (W.S. 15-5-201 et seq.); no active members.

systems.name: Wyoming Paid Firemen's Pension Plan B

statute.quote: "Account" means the firemen's pension account established by W.S. 15-5-202; (ii) "Board" means the retirement board established by W.S. 9-3-404

source.quote: "Board" means the retirement board established by W.S. 9-3-404 and includes all the powers and duties enumerated in W.S. 9-3-401 through 9-3-429;

website_source.quote: The Wyoming Retirement System administers pension and 457(b) deferred compensation plans for Wyoming's public employees.

systems.notes: Firemen's Pension Account Reform Act of 1981 (W.S. 15-5-401 et seq.) for paid firefighters hired on or after July 1, 1981.

systems.name: Wyoming Volunteer Firefighter, EMT and Search and Rescue Pension Fund

statute.quote: The volunteer firefighter, EMT and search and rescue pension account is created. All awards, benefits and pensions established under this article shall be paid from the account.

body.name: volunteer firefighter, EMT and search and rescue pension board, administered by the director of the Wyoming retirement system

source.quote: The account established under subsection (a) of this section shall be controlled by the board and administered by the director of the Wyoming retirement system.

website_source.quote: The Wyoming Retirement System administers pension and 457(b) deferred compensation plans for Wyoming's public employees.

systems.notes: Volunteer members of local fire departments, ambulance services and search and rescue units; the board is established by W.S. 35-9-623.
